title: Reviewing the Chris Ballard era: The 2019 draft class

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Reviewing the Chris Ballard era: The 2019 draft class
sources.description: With the 2017 and 2018 classes already reviewed, the next stop in the Chris Ballard draft review series is 2019. After a shaky first class and then a strong 2018 group that helped build Ballard’s reputation, the 2019 draft sits somewhere in the middle. It was not a complete disaster, but it was definitely underwhelming. […]
